children: Baron Fifth Avenue Growth Fund gained 24.6% (Institutional Shares) during the second quarter, which compares to gains of 16.7% for the Russell 1000 Growth Index (R1KG) and 15.2% for the S&P 500 Index
During the second quarter, the fund initiated a new position in the fast-inference semiconductor company, Cerebras
According to its quarterly fund letter, the fund also took advantage of stock price volatility to continue adding to its newer position in the electrical component supplier Amphenol
and also added to the pharmaceutical giant Eli Lilly
To fund these purchases, the fund slightly reduced 12 existing positions, including in Snowflake

title: Baron Fifth Avenue Growth Fund boosts APH, LLY stakes; trims SNOW, DDOG among Q2 moves
